title: Senior Product Manager - Core Experience
location: Berlin Office, Bosnia, Romania, Norway, Estonia, Latvia, Slovenia, Netherlands, Hungary, Portugal, Poland, Serbia, Germany, Austria, Finland, Albania, Lithuania, Slovakia, Ireland, Bulgaria, Denmark, Belgium, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Croatia, Spain, Greece
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.
n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.
We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
Your main goal will be to make building with n8n feel simple, powerful, and intuitive at every level, helping first-time users get to value quickly while enabling experienced builders to confidently create and run sophisticated workflows in production.
To do so, you’ll own high-impact product areas across n8n’s Experience: from identifying the biggest builder problems to shaping strategy, shipping solutions, and continuously improving them based on real usage:
MAKE THE CORE BUILDING EXPERIENCE EXCEPTIONAL
 - Identify and solve the highest-leverage problems across the workflow-building journey, making n8n easier to understand, faster to use, and more powerful as workflows grow in complexity.
 - Turn technically complex capabilities into polished, intuitive product experiences through close collaboration with Design and Engineering.
 - Continuously improve how users create, configure, debug, and evolve workflows, with a high bar for usability, performance, and reliability.
REDUCE FRICTION FROM FIRST WORKFLOW TO PRODUCTION
 - Find opportunities to dramatically shorten the path from an idea to a working workflow, particularly around setup, configuration, connectivity, and access to external services.
 - Shape experiences that make capabilities such as AI models, web search, integrations, and other services immediately useful while handling underlying complexity elegantly.
 - Balance simplicity with transparency and control so streamlined experiences continue to work for advanced, business-critical, and production use cases.
SHAPE THE FOUNDATIONS OF A POWERFUL BUILDER PLATFORM
 - Define product experiences and platform capabilities that make n8n flexible and extensible without exposing unnecessary complexity to users.
 - Improve how builders interact with integrations, data, credentials, schemas, reusable capabilities, and emerging standards such as MCP.
 - Partner with Engineering and developer-facing teams to ensure the product scales across an expanding ecosystem of services, use cases, and technical users.
DRIVE PRODUCT OUTCOMES THROUGH DISCOVERY, DATA, AND LEADERSHIP
 - Engage deeply with customers, community members, and internal teams to understand real workflows, pain points, and opportunities across the builder experience.
 - Define clear product bets, success metrics, and priorities, combining quantitative evidence with strong product judgment and fast learning loops.
 - Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data, DevRel, Docs, PMM, Support, and Customer Success through clear decisions, strong communication, and ownership of outcomes.
REQUIREMENTS
MUST-HAVES
 - Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped impactful software products in fast-moving environments and can clearly explain the outcomes, decisions, and tradeoffs you owned.
 - Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.
 - Excellent product & UX judgment: You’re known for simplifying complexity and have a strong instinct for what makes technical products intuitive, polished, and enjoyable to use.
 - Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.
 - Strong product discovery skills: You get close to users, uncover the underlying problem behind feature requests, validate assumptions, and turn insights into focused product decisions.
 - Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition 
 - AI-native product thinking: You actively use modern AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunities and product challenges created by AI-powered experiences.
NICE-TO-HAVES
 - Developer product experience: You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.
 - Integrations experience: You’ve worked on products involving third-party APIs, authentication, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems.
 - Community or open-source experience: You’ve built products alongside developer communities, contributors, or external ecosystems.
 - AI product experience: You’ve worked with LLMs, agents, model providers, evaluations, or other AI platform capabilities and understand their unique product tradeoffs.
 - Experimentation experience: You know how to use prototypes, experiments, and incremental releases to learn quickly without adding unnecessary process.

description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam.
Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues, both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business.
Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 - Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect https://connect.doctolib.com/fr/, identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value
 - Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights
 - Continuously measuring adoption, impact, and network health, iterating as needed to achieve desired outcomes for your product and company goals
 - Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network
 - Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leadership to ensure solutions serve users and meet business needs across target markets
WHO YOU ARE
Are you convinced that you have exactly what it takes for the position? Then we encourage you to apply. Even if you don't meet every requirement, you might be exactly the right future Doctoliber for this or other positions!
You could be our next team mate if you:
 - Have 4+ years of Product Management experience, including at least 1 year working on mobile applications, with a track record of shipping products that have delivered meaningful business results and proven user value
 - Have experience developing SaaS or mobile products, ideally including a network effect component such as social networking, communication services, or collaborative workplace tools
 - Approach problems with an analytical mindset, balancing quantitative and qualitative insights to make data-informed decisions
 - Communicate with clarity and conviction to align diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, driving vision and articulating user value and business impact
 - Are highly organised and disciplined in project management, with strong attention to detail and the confidence to ask tough questions and say no when needed
Now, it would be fantastic if you:
 - Have experience with health tech, marketplace, or platform products
 - Are familiar with operating in multi-market environments
 - Have worked in a scale-up or fast-paced product organisation
OUR AI VISION
We believe in the responsible use of AI to improve healthcare. Find out more about our approach here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/.
 What we offer:
 - Company pension scheme through our partner Allianz
 - 27 days of annual leave per year (and the ability to accrue more days on your work anniversary!)
 - Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
 - Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care http://Moka.care
 - Free breakfast and lunch plan every day on-site
 - Bike lease scheme with our partner Lease a Bike, 35% price below the market
 - Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
 - Discounted membership with Urban Sports Club
 - Continuous training programs on all key competencies (English, soft skills, expertise)
 - Reimbursement of public transportation if you live outside the Amsterdam highway ring
 - Parent Care Program: Various initiatives supporting parenthood, including 100% paid parental leave up to 16 weeks, including bonuses, for mothers and up to 5 weeks for the co-parent, flexible return and 3 days of leave per year for child sickness
 - Relocation support for international mobilities
THE INTERVIEW PROCESS
 - Recruiter Interview
 - Manager Interview
 - Case Study
 - Final Interview
 - Criminal background check and a copy of your Certificate of Good Conduct ("Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag, VOG") (if required)
JOB DETAILS
 - Permanent position
 - Full-Time
 - Amsterdam
 - Start date: As soon as possible
 - Compensation: fix + bonus on objectives (according to your profile)
At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.
The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.
To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote
 Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.
 About the Role
 Tebra is seeking a Senior Product Manager for our Patient Experience portfolio. You will help independent healthcare practices connect with patients and reduce administrative work. You will own product strategy and execution, turn customer needs into clear priorities, lead cross-functional teams from discovery through launch, and measure customer and business outcomes. You will bring practical AI fluency to both the products you build and the way you work. Scope may evolve across Patient Experience products, including calendar and scheduling capabilities, as customer needs and business priorities change. 
 Your Area of Focus
 Define and design features on one or more of Tebra’s core products that solve customer problems.
 Drive Message Center forward as a core Patient Experience product, improving patient and practice communication while partnering with Engineering, Legal, and Operations on application-to-person (A2P) messaging compliance, registration, consent, and delivery reliability.
 Identify where AI and automation can reduce practice staff effort or improve patient interactions. Use approved AI tools to synthesize research, explore solutions, build working prototypes, and test assumptions while validating outputs and protecting confidential data.
 Partner with technical teams to define AI quality measures, representative evaluation cases, human review and fallback paths, and launch criteria. Balance usefulness and accuracy with privacy, latency, and cost. 
 Perform market research, including defining and analyzing customer segments, reviewing industry research reports, assessing strengths and weaknesses of competitors, determining needs of different specialties, and studying pricing and packaging options.
 Collaborating cross-functionally to design features and processes for Tebra’s platform and customer experience.
 Research product positioning and provide recommendations to Product Marketing.
 Collecting feedback by reviewing customer support issues, administering user acceptance tests, reviewing sales win/loss data, and visiting customers to study product interaction in their natural environment.
 Preparing software design plans including product specifications, use case documentation, and user interface wireframes.
 Managing the customer experience roadmap, including documenting product strategy and owning the feature backlog.
 Analyze and prepare product usage reports on key product features and provide recommendations for the product roadmap.
 Stay current on industry-related regulatory and compliance requirements that pertain to healthcare technology.
 Your Professional Qualifications
 Must have 5+ years of experience in product, focused on software applications.
 Hands-on experience using generative AI in product work, with examples of prototypes, experiments, or workflow improvements that helped a team learn or deliver faster. Experience shipping and evaluating an AI-powered product capability in production is preferred.
 Working knowledge of large language models, prompting, retrieval, and agentic workflows, including their limitations. You can collaborate with technical partners on evaluations, human oversight, privacy, and responsible use.
 Demonstrated success with customer-facing products, complex workflows, and product strategy, with the ability to understand patient and independent practice needs.
 Proven track record as product manager at a successful B2B SaaS / Cloud software business with agile product management experience.
 Proven track record of executing complex product initiatives and processes with multiple stakeholders at senior and junior levels.
 Superior analytical and problem solving skills, with demonstrated analytical rigor, attention to detail, and the ability to structure and analyze sophisticated financial modeling.
 A flexible and creative thinker with the ability to define business trade-offs, generate out-of-the-box solutions and move through ambiguity.
 Prior experience developing products in the healthcare industry is preferred.

title: Group Product Manager  (Core)
description:
Headquarters: Spain - Remote
 Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. 
 Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. 
 Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.  
   About the Role:
 You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Wrike’s Core unit - the product area at the heart of how customers plan, structure, manage, and scale work in Wrike.
 In this role, you will lead a unit of five product teams and manage a team of five Product Managers. You will define the vision and strategy for Core Wrike going forward, balancing three critical forces: increasing product power, preserving ease of use, and evolving the experience to be suitable for the AI-native future.
 This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product judgment, people leadership, customer empathy, and strategic prioritization. You will help shape the foundation of Wrike’s product experience while developing a team of PMs into stronger strategic product leaders.
 Your Impact:
 Set the Core strategy: Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and priorities for Wrike’s Core unit, ensuring the product remains powerful, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI agents collaboration as well as for human.
 Lead a multi-team product area: Manage five Product Managers across five teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, strong decision-making, and consistent product quality across the unit.
 Prioritize ferociously: Balance customer requests, enterprise needs, technical investments, usability improvements, and long-term strategic bets — with a clear view of what matters most.
 Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to scale output and outcomes by 10x with AI-native ways of working.
 Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow Product Managers, helping them to achieve the next level.
 Your Qualifications:
 Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
 Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
 Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs, including scalability, adoption, usability, configurability, and change management.
 Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer escalations, technical complexity, and long-term platform direction.
 Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership.
 People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
 Excellent UX judgment: Ability to balance power and simplicity in complex product experiences.
 Standout Qualities:
 Experience in B2B SaaS enterprise products in collaboration or productivity area
 Practical understanding of AI-native product development and agentic workflows.
 Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex products vision
 Strong technical fluency and ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders.
 Our Work Style: 
 Core product impact: You will shape the foundational Wrike experience used by customers every day to manage work at scale.
 Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing power, simplicity, customer demand, technical depth, and AI-readiness in one of Wrike’s most important product areas.
 People leadership scope: You will directly develop a team of five PMs and influence the product culture of a larger R&D unit.
 AI-native transformation: You will help define how Core Wrike evolves for a future where AI changes how teams create, structure, and manage work.
 High visibility: Your decisions will influence Wrike’s product direction, customer value, and long-term competitiveness.

 Meeting with the hiring manager - Product Director
 Panel interview with Product, Engineering, and Design representatives

 We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

title: Staff Product Manager, Privacy
description:
Headquarters: Remote 
 Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.
 Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.
 We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 
 We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 
 Reporting to Sam Pinsak, Privacy’s Product Lead, who oversees both product and marketing, you'll partner closely with your engineering manager, eng lead, and the engineers on your pod, a product designer, and, depending on the work, leads across risk, payment, and dispute ops, compliance, biz ops, and support. The product team is small, senior, and moves fast. This is a hands-on role: you'll own a broad surface and live in the details — writing the specs, pulling the data you need to make a call, staying close to customers, and sitting in planning and grooming with your engineering squad. You're self-sufficient with data day to day and partner with an analyst on the deeper dives, and you lean on AI tooling to do the work of a much bigger team. Every bet ties back to the P&L, scope gets cut hard, and you'll have a short path to the CEO and to real customers.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Own the roadmap and strategy for a core product surface
 Own the surface and its year-long roadmap; keep the whole thing moving while going deep where it counts most right now
 Pick the right problems across that surface and frame them into testable bets with clear outcomes; set the product vision and strategy
 Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review
 Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding
 Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; know which levers move them and which to pull first to hit a target
 Reason in contribution-margin and unit-economics terms, not just feature impact; hold a segment-level model of our customers and spearhead the research that resolves high-impact, ambiguous questions
 Build the dashboards and success metrics other teams adopt, and use data to drive cross-functional buy-in
 Lead the team and work cross-functionally
 Lead an engineering squad as its product manager, and influence cross-functional teams to re-prioritize toward your roadmap
 Turn recurring decisions into playbooks the team reuses; push for configurable systems and AI/tooling patterns that lift the whole team, not just you
 Communicate clearly from the detail level up to the strategic picture, adapting to your audience; mentor other PMs and raise the team's craft bar
 What You’ll Bring: 
 Ownership of a product area (or multiple connected areas) end-to-end and set its strategy — not just execution of a roadmap handed to you
 Demonstrate strong judgment under ambiguity: you pick the right problems, make defensible calls, and know when to walk away from one
 Fluent in unit economics and how product decisions move the P&L
 Ability to find the levers that matter in performance data and turn them into a clear story for non-technical audiences
 Fluent with AI-assisted tools and actively building with them to multiply your own and the team's output
 Ability to ramp quickly across unfamiliar domains and get to real depth quickly
 Consumer or D2C product experience; consumer fintech or payments a strong plus, not a requirement
 Ability to operate autonomously, with strong communication skills, ruthless about scope without sacrificing quality, and humble
 The annual US salary range for this role is $ 168,000 - $225,000  plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 
 This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.
 Benefits for Full-Time US Employees:
 Unlimited PTO
 12-weeks fully paid parental leave
 4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary)
 Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year
 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account
 Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match
 401(k) match
 Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD
 NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.
 In-office employees receive: 
 Commuter benefit
 Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-staff-product-manager-privacy

title: Technical Product Owner – KI- & Datenprojekte (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Technical Product Owner (m/w/d) für KI- und Datenprojekte, unbefristet, in Voll- oder Teilzeit (mind. 35 Std./Woche). Bei uns ist die Rolle gleichzeitig Projektleitung: Du verantwortest die Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte vom ersten PoC bis in den Betrieb und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende ein messbarer Nutzen entsteht – nicht nur funktionierender Code.
 Dein Arbeitsort ist Berlin mit der Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten. Für Workshops und Steering-Termine vor Ort beim Kunden ist eine gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft notwendig. Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) in Wort und Schrift notwendig sind.
 Was wir tun 
 Alle machen jetzt KI – wir machen es schon lange! Als eines der ersten Beratungsunternehmen im Bereich angewandter Künstlicher Intelligenz befähigen wir seit 2017 Organisationen dazu, Daten und KI wertstiftend einzusetzen. Dabei gehen wir ganzheitlich vor und vereinen Daten- und KI-Strategien mit technischer Umsetzung von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven System. Zusätzlich befähigen wir Unternehmen und deren Mitarbeitende dazu, produktiv und verantwortungsvoll mit den implementierten KI-Lösungen umzugehen. Wir begreifen KI als Transformation und arbeiten deshalb gezielt an der Schnittstelle von Mensch, Strategie, Technologie und Design auf Projekten in Industrie, Wirtschaft, öffentlicher Verwaltung und Kultur.
 Wen wir suchen 
 Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens drei Jahre als (Technical) Product Owner oder Projektleitung mit Verantwortung für Scope und Budget.
 Du arbeitest sicher mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum und Kanban und passt dein Vorgehen an den Kontext an – vom kleinen Projektteam bis zur Konzern-IT.
 Du verstehst Softwarearchitekturen, APIs, Datenflüsse und Cloud-Grundlagen so gut, dass du Architekturen lesen und mitdiskutieren kannst. Selbst coden musst du nicht.
 Du übersetzt zwischen C-Level, Fachbereich und Entwicklungsteam und bringst Stakeholder auch dann zusammen, wenn ihre Interessen auseinandergehen.
 KI interessiert dich wirklich, und KI-Tools gehören selbstverständlich zu deinem Arbeitsalltag.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du schärfst gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen Produktvision und Ziele, schreibst Epics und User Stories mit klaren Akzeptanzkriterien und priorisierst das Backlog nach Business- und Nutzer:innen-Wert.
 Du moderierst Workshops mit Fachbereichen, übersetzt Anforderungen in technische Spezifikationen und bereitest Architektur- und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam vor.
 Du verantwortest Planung, Budget, Risiken, Reporting und Abnahmen und wählst die Methodik, die zum Projekt passt: Scrum, Kanban, hybrid oder klassisch.
 Du steuerst interdisziplinäre Projektteams aus Engineering, Strategie und Design fachlich und leitest Steering-Termine mit Stakeholdern bis hin zur Konzern-IT.
 Du bringst Datenschutz-, Security- und AI-Act-Anforderungen früh ins Backlog und begleitest Prototypen gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen durch deren Security-, Einkaufs- und Governance-Prozesse bis in den Betrieb.
 Du entwickelst unsere PO-Praxis mit, zum Beispiel die Frage, wie Specs und Akzeptanzkriterien aussehen müssen, wenn Teams mit Coding Agents arbeiten.
 Was dir bei der Arbeit helfen wird 
 Erfahrung in ML- oder LLM-Projekten, z. B. mit Evaluation und Datenqualität

title: Founders Associate
description:
### **About the Role**
Join the leadership team at a growing B2B technology and go-to-market services company. You will take ownership of strategic and operational projects, strengthen the company's financial and data foundations, and work closely with the founders to support sustainable growth.
### **What You'll Do**
* Lead strategic projects from initial analysis through execution, building scalable operating processes along the way.
* Own financial planning activities, including budgeting, forecasting, and processes that support sustainable growth.
* Identify opportunities to improve and automate workflows using AI tools and platforms such as Claude, n8n, Make.com, and Zapier.
* Develop business intelligence structures and data-driven insights using tools such as Snowflake and Looker Studio.
* Advise founders on business decisions and develop new business ideas and go-to-market strategies from concept to launch.
* Break down complex business questions into structured analyses, decision frameworks, and practical plans.
* Mentor team members and interns, and help foster a high-ownership culture.
### **What We're Looking For**
* A completed bachelor's or master's degree and 1 to 3 years of experience in a fast-moving environment such as a startup, consulting firm, or venture capital firm.
* Fluent German, at C2 or native level, and fluent English, both written and spoken.
* Experience with financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and building or improving operational processes.
* Hands-on experience with automation and AI tools such as n8n, Make.com, Zapier, Claude, or similar, plus familiarity with BI tools such as Snowflake or Looker Studio.
* Experience managing or mentoring team members or interns, developing go-to-market strategies, and launching business initiatives.
* Strong analytical skills, initiative, and an ownership mindset; B2B SaaS or technology experience and direct work with founders are beneficial.
* Based in Berlin or willing to relocate, and able to work from the office three days per week, with the first month on-site.
### **Compensation & Benefits**
Base salary: €65,000 to €75,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.
### **Location**
Hybrid, Berlin, Germany. The role requires three days per week in the office, with the first month on-site.
Compensation Range: €65K - €75K

title: SAP Project Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Stellen-ID: 11730 / Unbefristet / Start: Zum nächstmöglichen Termin
 Ich leite strategische SAP-Projekte, baue NEXUSLAB und ein neues Produktteam auf und entwickle mich schrittweise zur End-to-End Product Ownership.
 Das macht diesen Job für mich interessant: Hier übernehme ich nicht einfach ein etabliertes Produkt. Ich beginne damit, Projekte auf der SAP-Plattform zu leiten und erhalte parallel dazu die Möglichkeit, mein eigenes Produktteam zu formen und aufzubauen und in die End-to-End-Product-Ownership hineinzuwachsen.
 Meine Aufgaben
 Leitung komplexer, bereichsübergreifender Projekte und strategischer Initiativen auf der SAP-Plattform von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung,
 Steuerung von Projektplänen, Meilensteinen, Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und kritischen Pfaden sowie transparente Berichterstattung zum Projektfortschritt,
 Koordination funktionsübergreifender Teams, Fachbereiche und externer Partner bei unternehmensweiten Rollouts,
 Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von NEXUSLAB als integriertes Plattformprodukt auf Basis von SAP LeanIX, SAP Signavio und Tricentis Test Management,
 Entwicklung von Produktvision, Roadmap und Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam mit Stakeholdern, internen Kunden und dem zukünftigen Produktteam,
 Schrittweiser Aufbau des Produktteams und Entwicklung von der Projektleitung hin zur End-to-End Product Ownership.
 Meine Kompetenzen 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation,
 Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer, funktionsübergreifender IT-Projekte sowie sicherer Umgang mit strukturierten Projektmanagementmethoden,
 Praktische Erfahrung mit Jira sowie Projektplanungs- und Visualisierungstools, insbesondere für Projektpläne, Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten und kritische Pfade,
 Erfahrung mit unternehmensweiten IT-Rollouts und der Verzahnung von technischer Umsetzung, Change Management, Kommunikation, Schulung und Hypercare,
 Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, komplexe Vorhaben mit mehreren Teams, Fachbereichen und externen Partnern zu strukturieren und verlässlich zur Umsetzung zu bringen,
 Erfahrung in der Anwendung KI-gestützter Tools im beruflichen Kontext,
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.
 Kein Muss, aber von Vorteil
 Erfahrung mit Product Ownership oder agiler Produktentwicklung,
 Kenntnisse in SAP LeanIX, SAP Signavio, Tricentis oder vergleichbaren Unternehmensplattformen,
 Erfahrung im Aufbau neuer Produkte, Teams oder Arbeitsweisen.
 Flexikompass - so flexibel ist dieser Job
 Arbeitszeit: 37 Wochenstunden (Vollzeit),
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Langzeitkonto zur Unterstützung der Work-Life-Balance,
 Die Zahl der Gleittage ist nicht begrenzt,
 Keine Kernarbeitszeit,
 Mobiles Arbeiten (teilweise von zuhause) möglich.
